scripts.// test: -r so every workspace runs. The engine's SSE and reconciliation suites existed but were never executed by the default command, which makes them decorative.
scripts.// runtimes: Use `pnpm runtimes`. `pnpm doctor` silently runs PNPM's builtin doctor instead of this script — pnpm resolves the builtin before consulting package.json, so no script name can win that collision.
scripts.// check: Static checks that typecheck and the test suite cannot see: stray control bytes, undefined CSS classes and custom properties, responsive rules, dead exports. Each one caught a real bug that everything else reported as fine.
scripts.// doctor: `run` is explicit because `doctor` is also a pnpm builtin: without it, pnpm runs the builtin and fails with Unknown option: recursive.
